# Database schema

<!-- Generated by tools/schema-doc.php from system/sql/schema.sql and system/sql/names.php – do not edit by hand. -->

Every table of a new installation, with its columns and the comments of `system/sql/schema.sql`. The prefix `ka_` is the
one from `config.php`. Older tables and columns have Czech names (they are never renamed); the **English** column gives the
name from the rename map `system/sql/names.php` (`Core\Names`) – code may write `{news}` as well as `{novinky}` – and,
for the mapped columns, their English meaning. Older identifiers: `idc` = news item, `tema`/`idt` = category, `ido` =
media item, `idu` = user.

## ka_uzivatele

English name: `users`.

| Column | English | Type | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `idu` | `id` | INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT |  |
| `user` |  | VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL | sign-in name |
| `password` |  | VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL | password_hash() |
| `jmeno` | `name` | VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' |  |
| `email` |  | VARCHAR(190) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' |  |
| `url` |  | VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' |  |
| `admin` |  | TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 | role: 0 author, 1 editor, 2 administrator |
| `role` |  | INT UNSIGNED NULL | custom role (ka_role); NULL = only the level from admin |
| `blokovat` | `blocked` | BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 |  |
| `blokovano_automaticky` |  | DATETIME NULL | when the automatic suspension blocked the account (Core\SecurityHygiene); NULL = not by it |
| `pocet_chyb` |  | SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 | failed sign-ins in a row |
| `zamceno_do` |  | DATETIME NULL | temporary lock after 10 failed sign-ins |
| `obnova_otisk` |  | CHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | sha256 of the one-time token for a password reset by e-mail; empty = nothing pending |
| `obnova_cas` |  | DATETIME NULL | when the password reset link was sent (valid for an hour) |
| `totp_tajemstvi` | `totp_secret` | VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | two-factor sign-in (TOTP); empty = off; 3.39 (N106): sealed with the key in config.php ("kaleta-sealed:…", Core\Vault) |
| `totp_zalozni` |  | TEXT NULL | JSON: hashes of one-time backup codes |
| `posledni_login` | `last_login_at` | DATETIME NULL | last completed sign-in to the administration |
| `potvrzeno` |  | DATETIME NULL | created or last confirmed by an administrator (saved in Users, reactivated) – the unused-account check counts from it |
| `jazyk` | `language` | VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | admin language; '' = Czech |
| `register` |  | VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | form of address in the German administration: '' = formal (Sie), 'informal' = du |
| `pozice` |  | VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | position in the company (bio of the news author) |
| `foto` |  | VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' |  |
| `bio` |  | TEXT NULL | a few sentences about the author |
| `team_item_id` |  | INT UNSIGNED NULL | the person's record in the Team collection (3.14, Builder\TeamRecord); NULL = by the e-mail |
| `notify_email` |  | VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'instant' | e-mail for notifications: instant \| daily \| off (3.26, migration 0112) |
| `passkey_handle` |  | VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | opaque WebAuthn user handle (base64url, 3.35, migration 0121); '' = none yet |
| `passkey_only` |  | BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 | the account signs in with a passkey only (applies once it has a working passkey; 3.35) |
| `phone` |  | VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | work phone, shown to colleagues and in the fallback e-mail signature (3.37, migration 0122) |
| `sign_in_epoch` |  | INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 | raised by every change of the second factor; other sign-ins with an older value end (3.41 N116, migration 0130) |
| `department_id` |  | INT UNSIGNED NULL | ka_departments.id (3.42, migration 0132); no foreign key – a removed department leaves NULL in code |
| `reports_to` |  | INT UNSIGNED NULL | the account this person reports to (3.42); escalation of overdue tasks, the org chart |

Keys: `PRIMARY KEY (idu)`; `UNIQUE KEY uq_user (user)`.

## ka_role

English name: `roles`. Custom roles: a named set of admin sections and a level (0 = writes own news items, 1 = publishes and manages everyone's content).

| Column | English | Type | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `idr` | `id` | INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT |  |
| `nazev` | `name` | VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL |  |
| `popis` |  | VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' |  |
| `uroven` |  | TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 |  |
| `moduly` |  | VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | comma-separated section identifiers |

Keys: `PRIMARY KEY (idr)`; `UNIQUE KEY uq_role_nazev (nazev)`.

## ka_uzivatele_prava

English name: `user_modules`. User access to an admin module

| Column | English | Type | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fk_id_user` |  | INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL |  |

Keys: `PRIMARY KEY (fk_id_user, ident_modulu)`; `CONSTRAINT fk_prava_user FOREIGN KEY (fk_id_user) REFERENCES ka_uzivatele (idu) ON DELETE CASCADE`.

## ka_novinky

English name: `news`.

| Column | English | Type | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `idc` | `id` | INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT |  |
| `seo_link` | `slug` | VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL |  |
| `titulek` | `title` | VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL |  |
| `uvod` | `intro` | MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL | intro |
| `text` |  | MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL |  |
| `obrazek` | `image` | VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | featured image |
| `obrazek_popis` |  | VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | caption of the featured image (empty = the caption from the media library) |
| `obrazek_autor` |  | VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | author of the featured image (empty = the author from the media library) |
| `tema` | `category_id` | INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL | category |
| `autor` | `author_id` | INT UNSIGNED NULL |  |
| `datum` | `published_at` | DATETIME NOT NULL | publish date (also a future one) |
| `visible` |  | BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 | published news item (otherwise a draft) |
| `t_slova` | `keywords` | VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | keywords |
| `seo_titulek` |  | VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | custom <title>, empty = the title |
| `seo_popis` |  | VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | custom meta description, empty = from the intro |
| `noindex` |  | BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 |  |
| `canonical_url` |  | VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | canonical address (3.22, Core\CanonicalUrl): https://… or a path on the site, empty = the news item itself |
| `faq` |  | TEXT NULL | questions and answers: question, the answer below it, an empty line |
| `visit` |  | INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 | view count |
| `zmeneno` |  | DATETIME NULL |  |
| `aktualizovano` | `revised_at` | DATETIME NULL | when the published news item was substantially updated |
| `oznameno` | `announced_at` | DATETIME NULL | when the system announced the publishing (webhook, IndexNow); NULL = not yet |
| `valid_until` |  | DATE NULL | true until: the day after, the news item hides itself (2.10, Core\Validity) |
| `review_by` |  | DATE NULL | review by: on this day the site audit asks for a check (2.10) |
| `jazyk` | `language` | VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | taken from the category on save |
| `preklad_z` | `translation_of` | INT UNSIGNED NULL | idc of the news item this one is a translation of |
| `hledani` | `search_text` | MEDIUMTEXT NULL | text without diacritics for search (Core\Search) |
| `odkazy_cas` |  | DATETIME NULL | when the links were last checked |
| `smazano` | `deleted_at` | DATETIME NULL | in the trash since (deleted permanently after 30 days); NULL = not in the trash |

Keys: `PRIMARY KEY (idc)`; `UNIQUE KEY uq_clanky_jazyk_seo (jazyk, seo_link)`; `KEY ix_clanky_seo (seo_link)`; `KEY ix_clanky_jazyk (jazyk, visible, datum)`; `KEY ix_clanky_oznameno (oznameno, visible, datum)`; `KEY ix_clanky_datum (datum)`; `KEY ix_clanky_smazano (smazano)`; `KEY ix_clanky_tema (tema, visible, datum)`; `KEY ix_clanky_autor (autor)`; `FULLTEXT KEY ft_clanky (titulek, uvod, text, t_slova)`; `FULLTEXT KEY ft_clanky_hledani (hledani)`; `CONSTRAINT fk_clanky_tema FOREIGN KEY (tema) REFERENCES ka_kategorie (idt)`; `CONSTRAINT fk_clanky_autor FOREIGN KEY (autor) REFERENCES ka_uzivatele (idu) ON DELETE SET NULL`.

## ka_comments

Internal comments of the team on a record (3.25, Core\Comments): appended, never overwritten. target = what they are about ('enquiry:12'; later 'page:5', 'item:9'), kind = 'note' (an internal note the customer never sees). Enquiry notes follow the enquiry: deleted with it (Core\Comments::forgetEnquiries – no foreign key, the target is text), blanked when it is anonymised (who and when stay). author_name keeps the name as it was when written. One person each (assignee_id; NULL only after a leaver's work went to nobody), optionally about a record (target 'enquiry:<idp>' | 'page:<ids>' | 'item:<idp>' – text, no foreign key: the task follows its record, deleted with it, the title blanked when an enquiry is anonymised). The job "tasks" notifies once per task when remind_at (or due_at) has passed (notified_at). request_id = handed to Claude as a request (the task is then done).

## ka_deals

3.31: the lean pipeline (Core\Deals) – deals moving through the stages of the one pipeline (setting pipeline_stages). A deal may name its contact, company, responsible person and the enquiry it came from (one open deal per enquiry); a value is a number with its currency. Won and lost close it (closed_at; lost with lost_reason from a short list and an optional lost_note); reopening clears them. No foreign keys: the links follow their records in code.

## ka_internal_folders

3.42: internal files (Core\InternalFiles, admin Workspace → Internal files) – a document library for the team that is never public: no page, search, sitemap, llms.txt, export, blueprint, page package, heartbeat or media picker reads these tables (a unit test keeps them inside the allowed classes). ## ka_collection_categories

Categories of a collection (3.7, Builder\CollectionCategories): two levels – a category and its subcategories – each with a landing page /<collection>/<category> and /<collection>/<category>/<subcategory> drawn by the collection's category template. The tree, the order, the image and the visibility are shared by every language; the name, the address and the texts are per language (ka_collection_category_texts) – a category is in a language version when it has a text row there. A category address never equals an item address of the same collection (refused on save, both ways).

| Column | English | Type | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` |  | INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT |  |
| `idk` |  | INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL | the collection (ka_kolekce) |
| `parent_id` |  | INT UNSIGNED NULL | the top-level category of a subcategory; NULL = a top-level category |
| `image` |  | VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | a path in Media or an https address |
| `sort_order` |  | INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 100 |  |
| `visible` |  | TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 | a hidden category has no page and is in no list (a draft from a drafts-only connection) |
| `updated_at` |  | DATETIME NULL |  |

Keys: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`; `KEY ix_collection_categories (idk, parent_id, sort_order)`; `KEY ix_collection_categories_parent (parent_id)`; `CONSTRAINT fk_collection_categories_collection FOREIGN KEY (idk) REFERENCES ka_kolekce (idk) ON DELETE CASCADE`; `CONSTRAINT fk_collection_categories_parent FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES ka_collection_categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE`.

## ka_oauth_rotated

Refresh tokens exchanged for a new pair (3.3.4, Front\OAuth::refresh): within REFRESH_GRACE seconds the old token returns the same pair again, later it revokes the client's tokens for the user (reuse = theft).

| Column | English | Type | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hash` |  | CHAR(64) NOT NULL | sha256 of the rotated refresh token |
| `client_id` |  | CHAR(32) NOT NULL |  |
| `idu` |  | INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL |  |
| `salt` |  | CHAR(64) NOT NULL | with the old token it derives the pair it was rotated into |
| `rotated_at` |  | DATETIME NOT NULL |  |
| `expires_at` |  | DATETIME NOT NULL | the record goes then: OAuth::ROTATED_LIFETIME after the rotation (3.10.1), at most the old token's expiry |

Keys: `PRIMARY KEY (hash)`; `KEY ix_oauth_rotated_client (client_id, idu)`; `KEY ix_oauth_rotated_at (rotated_at)`.

Agent notebook (2.15, Core\Notebook): notes for whoever works on the site next – Claude in a new conversation or a colleague: decisions ("we never use the word cheap"), style rules, photo credits, the history of the redesign, what the client is sensitive about. Pinned notes come first; the author is the user's name or the Claude connection name.

| `text` |  | TEXT NOT NULL | plain text |
| `pinned` |  | TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 |  |
| `author` |  | VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | the user's name, or the name of the Claude connection |
| `via` |  | VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | 3.39 (N110): the Claude connection it was written through; '' = a person in the administration |
| `access` |  | VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | 3.39 (N110): that connection's access (full \| drafts); drafts = a proposal (never pinned) |
| `created_at` |  | DATETIME NOT NULL |  |
| `updated_at` |  | DATETIME NOT NULL |  |

Keys: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`; `KEY ix_notebook_topic (topic, pinned, updated_at)`.

## ka_requests

Requests to Claude (2.15, Core\Requests): staff write what they need changed on the site in the administration ("change the opening hours on Monday", "add this PDF to the price list"); Claude reads them over MCP, works as drafts and answers with notes; a person publishes. Attachments are ordinary Media uploads (ka_media.ido), so Claude can use them. Not in the site export: a request is work for the team, not content of the site.

| Column | English | Type | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` |  | INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT |  |
| `created_at` |  | DATETIME NOT NULL |  |
| `updated_at` |  | DATETIME NOT NULL |  |
| `author_id` |  | INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL | ka_uzivatele.idu of the staff member who wrote it |
| `title` |  | VARCHAR(190) NOT NULL |  |
| `text` |  | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| `about` |  | VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | what it is about: page:<ids> \| news:<idc> \| item:<idp> \| a URL \| '' |
| `attachments` |  | VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' | JSON list of ka_media.ido (up to 5) |
| `status` |  | VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new' | new \| in_progress \| done \| declined |
| `done_at` |  | DATETIME NULL | when it was marked done or declined |

Keys: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`; `KEY ix_requests_status (status, id)`.

## ka_agent_schedules

Scheduled Claude runs (2.17, Core\AgentSchedules): the site keeps the schedules (a weekly review, a monthly report, a daily triage of enquiries, the open requests, or the administrator's own instructions), tells a Claude routine what is due (get_due_agent_runs), records each run (report_agent_run) and notices runs nobody picked up. The site cannot run Claude by itself: the run happens in Claude, over a drafts-only connection. Not in the site export: the schedule belongs to the team working on the site, not to its content.

| Column | English | Type | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` |  | INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT |  |
| `name` |  | VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL |  |
| `task` |  | VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL | review \| report \| triage \| requests \| custom |
| `text` |  | TEXT NOT NULL | the instructions of a custom task; optional extra for the others |
| `cadence` |  | VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL | daily \| weekly \| monthly |
| `day` |  | TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 | weekly: ISO weekday 1–7; monthly: day of month 1–28 |
| `time` |  | CHAR(5) NOT NULL DEFAULT '07:00' | HH:MM in the site's time zone |
| `active` |  | TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 |  |
| `next_due` |  | DATETIME NULL | the next moment a run is handed out (site time) |
| `last_run_at` |  | DATETIME NULL |  |
| `created_at` |  | DATETIME NOT NULL |  |

Keys: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`; `KEY ix_agent_schedules_due (active, next_due)`.

One run of a schedule: handed out (running) until the routine reports it (ok | partial | failed), or missed when nobody picked it up within 6 hours. The summary and the links to the drafts are what the routine reported.

| `connection` |  | VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | the name of the Claude connection that did the run |

Keys: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`; `KEY ix_agent_runs_schedule (schedule_id, id)`; `CONSTRAINT fk_agent_runs_schedule FOREIGN KEY (schedule_id) REFERENCES ka_agent_schedules (id) ON DELETE CASCADE`.

## ka_monthly_reports

The archive of the monthly reports (3.16, Core\ReportArchive): the report of a past month (Core\MonthlyReport::build) as JSON, kept 24 months. Built by a background job once the month has turned, independent of the e-mail; its sources are kept 30–180 days only, so this is the only copy of an older month. Counts, titles and paths, never personal data.

| `schema_version` |  | SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 | ReportArchive::SCHEMA of the JSON |
| `data` |  | MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL | the built report (JSON) |

Keys: `PRIMARY KEY (id)`; `UNIQUE KEY ux_monthly_reports_month (month)`.
